# DDev

DDev is the personal cross-repository development harness. A project only needs the `ddev` entry skill; capability modules stay in the global Dewey asset cache and are loaded by DDev through absolute paths when needed.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install -g deweyou-cli
deweyou-cli agent update
deweyou-cli agent init --skills ddev --rules ddev-local-state,verification-evidence,loop-boundaries --mode link --yes
deweyou-cli dev install
deweyou-cli dev doctor
```
